anatomy.en: Early doctors learned about human anatomy by studying the bodies of animals.
anatomy.zh: 早期的医生通过研究动物的身体来了解人体解剖学。

physiology.en: The study of physiology explains how different parts of the body work.
physiology.zh: 生理学研究解释了身体各部分如何运作。

cell.en: Every cell in the body contains a complete set of genes.
cell.zh: 体内每个细胞都含有一整套基因。

tissue.en: The drug is designed to repair damaged tissue in the muscles of the heart.
tissue.zh: 这种药物旨在修复心肌中受损的组织。

organ.en: The liver is one of the largest organs in the human body.
organ.zh: 肝脏是人体最大的器官之一。

skeleton.en: The complete skeleton of a young woman was found near the old wall.
skeleton.zh: 在古墙附近发现了一具完整的年轻女性骨骼。

muscle.en: Regular training helps to build muscle and improve general health.
muscle.zh: 经常训练有助于增强肌肉、改善整体健康。

nerve.en: A damaged nerve may take many months to grow back.
nerve.zh: 受损的神经可能需要数月才能长回来。

neuron.en: Each neuron in the brain can connect with thousands of others.
neuron.zh: 大脑中的每个神经元都能与数千个其他神经元相连。

spinal-cord.en: The spinal cord carries messages between the brain and the rest of the body.
spinal-cord.zh: 脊髓在大脑和身体其他部位之间传递信息。

artery.en: A blocked artery can reduce the flow of blood to the heart.
artery.zh: 动脉堵塞可能减少流向心脏的血液。

vein.en: Blood returns to the heart through a vein after delivering oxygen.
vein.zh: 血液输送氧气后通过静脉回到心脏。

blood-vessel.en: Smoking damages the walls of the blood vessels and raises the risk of illness.
blood-vessel.zh: 吸烟会损害血管壁,增加患病风险。

circulation.en: Regular walking can improve blood circulation in older people.
circulation.zh: 经常散步可以改善老年人的血液循环。

circulation.en: The newspaper had a daily circulation of more than a million copies.
circulation.zh: 这份报纸的日发行量超过一百万份。

digestion.en: Fibre in the diet plays an important part in healthy digestion.
digestion.zh: 饮食中的纤维对健康的消化起着重要作用。

digestive.en: The digestive system breaks food down into substances the body can use.
digestive.zh: 消化系统把食物分解成身体可以利用的物质。

metabolism.en: Metabolism tends to slow down as people get older.
metabolism.zh: 随着年龄增长,新陈代谢往往会减慢。

respiratory.en: Air pollution can lead to serious respiratory problems among children.
respiratory.zh: 空气污染可能导致儿童出现严重的呼吸问题。

immune-system.en: Lack of sleep can weaken the immune system over time.
immune-system.zh: 长期睡眠不足会削弱免疫系统。

immunity.en: Vaccines provide immunity against a number of dangerous diseases.
immunity.zh: 疫苗能提供针对多种危险疾病的免疫力。

antibody.en: The body produces an antibody to fight each new infection.
antibody.zh: 身体针对每种新的感染都会产生抗体。

hormone.en: Stress causes the body to release a hormone called cortisol.
hormone.zh: 压力使身体释放一种叫皮质醇的激素。

enzyme.en: An enzyme in the stomach helps to break down protein.
enzyme.zh: 胃中的一种酶有助于分解蛋白质。

dna.en: Scientists extracted DNA from the ancient bones found in the cave.
dna.zh: 科学家从洞穴中发现的古代骨骼里提取了 DNA。

chromosome.en: Humans normally have twenty-three pairs of chromosomes in each cell.
chromosome.zh: 人类每个细胞通常有二十三对染色体。

bacteria.en: Some bacteria in the gut are essential for good health.
bacteria.zh: 肠道中的一些细菌对健康至关重要。

virus.en: The virus spreads through the air when an infected person coughs.
virus.zh: 感染者咳嗽时,病毒通过空气传播。

virus.en: A computer virus damaged the hospital's records and delayed treatment.
virus.zh: 一种计算机病毒损坏了医院的记录,延误了治疗。

microbe.en: A single spoonful of soil may contain millions of microbes.
microbe.zh: 一小勺土壤可能含有数百万个微生物。

germ.en: Hand washing removes most of the germs that cause common illnesses.
germ.zh: 洗手能去除大部分导致常见疾病的病菌。

pathogen.en: A pathogen may pass from animals to humans through contact or food.
pathogen.zh: 病原体可能通过接触或食物从动物传给人类。

disorder.en: Sleep disorders can have a serious effect on everyday life.
disorder.zh: 睡眠障碍可能严重影响日常生活。

chronic.en: Chronic back pain is one of the most common reasons for missing work.
chronic.zh: 慢性背痛是请假最常见的原因之一。

acute.en: Patients with acute pain were treated immediately in the emergency room.
acute.zh: 急性疼痛的患者在急诊室立即得到治疗。

acute.en: Dogs have an acute sense of smell that can detect some diseases.
acute.zh: 狗有敏锐的嗅觉,能察觉某些疾病。

epidemic.en: A flu epidemic killed millions of people around the world in 1918.
epidemic.zh: 1918 年的流感疫情造成全球数百万人死亡。

pandemic.en: A pandemic affects people across many countries at the same time.
pandemic.zh: 大流行病会同时影响许多国家的人。

contagious.en: The illness is highly contagious and spreads easily through physical contact.
contagious.zh: 这种疾病传染性极强,很容易通过身体接触传播。

infectious.en: Vaccines have greatly reduced deaths from infectious diseases.
infectious.zh: 疫苗大大减少了传染病造成的死亡。

outbreak.en: An outbreak of food poisoning closed several restaurants in the town.
outbreak.zh: 一场食物中毒事件的爆发导致镇上几家餐厅关闭。

diabetes.en: Being overweight greatly increases the risk of developing diabetes.
diabetes.zh: 超重会大大增加患糖尿病的风险。

obesity.en: Rates of obesity among children have risen sharply in many countries.
obesity.zh: 在许多国家,儿童肥胖率急剧上升。

tumour.en: Surgeons removed the tumour, and the patient made a full recovery.
tumour.zh: 外科医生切除了肿瘤,患者完全康复了。

stroke.en: A stroke happens when the supply of blood to the brain is blocked.
stroke.zh: 当大脑的血液供应被阻断时,就会发生中风。

heart-attack.en: A healthy diet can reduce the risk of having a heart attack.
heart-attack.zh: 健康饮食可以降低心脏病发作的风险。

blood-pressure.en: High blood pressure often has no obvious symptoms in its early stages.
blood-pressure.zh: 高血压在早期通常没有明显症状。

cholesterol.en: Foods high in fat can raise the level of cholesterol in the blood.
cholesterol.zh: 高脂肪食物可能升高血液中的胆固醇水平。

asthma.en: Dust and pollution can make asthma much worse in young children.
asthma.zh: 灰尘和污染可能使幼儿的哮喘严重恶化。

dementia.en: Older people with dementia may forget the names of close family members.
dementia.zh: 患痴呆的老人可能会忘记亲人的名字。

alzheimers-disease.en: Alzheimer's disease gradually destroys memory and the ability to think clearly.
alzheimers-disease.zh: 阿尔茨海默病会逐渐破坏记忆和清晰思考的能力。

depression.en: Regular exercise can reduce the symptoms of mild depression.
depression.zh: 经常运动可以减轻轻度抑郁症的症状。

depression.en: Millions of people lost their jobs during the economic depression of the 1930s.
depression.zh: 20 世纪 30 年代的经济萧条期间,数百万人失业。

vaccine.en: Researchers developed the new vaccine in less than a year.
vaccine.zh: 研究者用不到一年的时间研制出了这种新疫苗。

antibiotic.en: Antibiotics do not work against illnesses caused by viruses.
antibiotic.zh: 抗生素对病毒引起的疾病不起作用。

drug.en: The new drug is being tested on a small group of patients.
drug.zh: 这种新药正在一小组患者身上进行测试。

medication.en: Patients must take this medication every day for at least three months.
medication.zh: 患者必须每天服用这种药物,至少三个月。

dose.en: A small dose of the drug is enough to relieve the pain.
dose.zh: 小剂量的这种药就足以缓解疼痛。

side-effect.en: A common side effect of the medicine is feeling tired during the day.
side-effect.zh: 这种药的一个常见副作用是白天感到疲倦。

placebo.en: Half of the patients were given a placebo instead of the real drug.
placebo.zh: 一半的患者服用的是安慰剂,而不是真正的药物。

clinical-trial.en: The vaccine will enter a clinical trial with two thousand volunteers.
clinical-trial.zh: 这种疫苗将进入有两千名志愿者参加的临床试验。

cure.en: There is still no cure for the common cold.
cure.zh: 普通感冒仍然没有治愈的方法。

cure.en: Doctors can now cure most people who develop this type of cancer.
cure.zh: 现在医生能够治愈大多数患这类癌症的人。

heal.en: Wounds heal more slowly in older people than in the young.
heal.zh: 老年人的伤口愈合得比年轻人慢。

recover.en: Most patients recover completely within two or three weeks.
recover.zh: 大多数患者在两三周内完全康复。

recovery.en: Good sleep plays an important part in recovery after an illness.
recovery.zh: 良好的睡眠对病后康复起着重要作用。

rehabilitation.en: Rehabilitation after a serious injury may take many months.
rehabilitation.zh: 重伤后的康复可能需要几个月。

transplant.en: A heart transplant can give a seriously ill patient many more years of life.
transplant.zh: 心脏移植能让重病患者多活很多年。

transplant.en: Surgeons can now transplant organs from one person to another safely.
transplant.zh: 现在外科医生能够安全地把器官从一个人移植到另一个人身上。

anaesthetic.en: The use of anaesthetic made surgery far less painful in the nineteenth century.
anaesthetic.zh: 十九世纪麻醉剂的使用大大减轻了手术的痛苦。

genome.en: The human genome contains around twenty thousand genes.
genome.zh: 人类基因组包含约两万个基因。

life-expectancy.en: Life expectancy has risen steadily in most countries over the last century.
life-expectancy.zh: 过去一个世纪,大多数国家的预期寿命持续上升。

mortality.en: Infant mortality fell sharply after clean water was introduced to the city.
mortality.zh: 城市引入清洁水后,婴儿死亡率急剧下降。

longevity.en: Diet and regular exercise appear to be linked to longevity.
longevity.zh: 饮食和经常运动似乎与长寿有关。

hygiene.en: Better hygiene in hospitals has greatly reduced the risk of infection.
hygiene.zh: 医院卫生条件的改善大大降低了感染风险。

sanitation.en: Poor sanitation is a major cause of disease in crowded urban areas.
sanitation.zh: 卫生设施差是拥挤城区疾病的主要成因。

malnutrition.en: Malnutrition affects the physical and mental development of young children.
malnutrition.zh: 营养不良影响幼儿的身心发育。

deficiency.en: A deficiency of vitamin C can cause serious problems with the gums.
deficiency.zh: 缺乏维生素 C 可能导致严重的牙龈问题。

diet.en: A diet rich in fruit and vegetables may help to prevent heart disease.
diet.zh: 富含水果和蔬菜的饮食可能有助于预防心脏病。

sedentary.en: A sedentary lifestyle is linked to a higher risk of many diseases.
sedentary.zh: 久坐的生活方式与多种疾病的较高风险有关。

syndrome.en: The syndrome causes extreme tiredness that can last for several months.
syndrome.zh: 这种综合征会引起持续数月的极度疲劳。

hypertension.en: Too much salt in the diet is one cause of hypertension.
hypertension.zh: 饮食中盐分过多是高血压的成因之一。

malaria.en: Malaria is spread by mosquitoes and remains a serious threat in Africa.
malaria.zh: 疟疾由蚊子传播,在非洲仍是严重威胁。

infect.en: The virus can infect people of all ages, but children suffer most.
infect.zh: 这种病毒能感染所有年龄段的人,但儿童受害最重。

inject.en: Doctors inject the vaccine into the upper part of the arm.
inject.zh: 医生把疫苗注射到上臂。

dissect.en: Medical students learn to dissect bodies in order to understand anatomy.
dissect.zh: 医学生学习解剖遗体,以了解人体结构。

clot.en: A blood clot in the leg can become dangerous if it moves to the lungs.
clot.zh: 腿部的血块如果移动到肺部,可能会很危险。

paralysed.en: He was left partly paralysed after the accident damaged his spine.
paralysed.zh: 事故损伤了他的脊柱,使他部分瘫痪。

malnourished.en: Many of the children in the camp were seriously malnourished.
malnourished.zh: 营地里的许多孩子严重营养不良。

handicap.en: Poor eyesight was once a serious handicap for people in many jobs.
handicap.zh: 视力差曾是许多工作中的严重障碍。

spleen.en: The spleen helps to filter the blood and fight infection.
spleen.zh: 脾有助于过滤血液和抵抗感染。

life-span.en: The average life-span of a wild fox is only about three years.
life-span.zh: 野生狐狸的平均寿命只有大约三年。

death-rate.en: The death rate from the disease fell after the vaccine was introduced.
death-rate.zh: 疫苗推出后,这种疾病的死亡率下降了。

heart-rate.en: Your heart rate increases naturally when you take exercise.
heart-rate.zh: 运动时心率会自然升高。

flesh.en: The bacteria spread quickly through the flesh of the infected animal.
flesh.zh: 细菌在受感染动物的肌肉中迅速扩散。

lung.en: Smoking is the main cause of lung cancer in most countries.
lung.zh: 在大多数国家,吸烟是肺癌的主要成因。

limb.en: Some lizards can grow a new limb if one is lost.
limb.zh: 有些蜥蜴失去肢体后能再长出新的。

liver.en: The liver removes harmful substances from the blood.
liver.zh: 肝脏清除血液中的有害物质。

gut.en: The bacteria in the gut may affect both mood and weight.
gut.zh: 肠道中的细菌可能同时影响情绪和体重。

lump.en: Doctors check any new lump carefully to see if it is dangerous.
lump.zh: 医生会仔细检查任何新出现的肿块,看看是否危险。

strand.en: A single strand of hair can provide a surprising amount of information.
strand.zh: 一根头发就能提供惊人的大量信息。

membrane.en: A thin membrane controls what enters and leaves each cell.
membrane.zh: 一层薄膜控制着物质进出每个细胞。

complication.en: Serious complications can occur if the infection is not treated quickly.
complication.zh: 如果感染不及时治疗,可能出现严重的并发症。

kidney.en: The kidneys remove waste from the blood and control the body's water.
kidney.zh: 肾脏清除血液中的废物,并调节体内水分。

incidence.en: The incidence of skin cancer is higher in sunny countries.
incidence.zh: 阳光充足的国家皮肤癌的发病率更高。

onset.en: Exercise may delay the onset of memory problems in later life.
onset.zh: 运动可能推迟晚年记忆问题的发生。

bodily.en: Sleep affects many bodily functions, including digestion and breathing.
bodily.zh: 睡眠影响许多身体机能,包括消化和呼吸。

urine.en: Doctors can test a patient's urine to check for signs of diabetes.
urine.zh: 医生可以检测患者的尿液,查找糖尿病的迹象。

susceptible.en: Elderly people are more susceptible to infection during the winter months.
susceptible.zh: 老年人在冬季更容易受到感染。

sperm.en: A number of chemicals in the environment may reduce sperm counts in men.
sperm.zh: 环境中的一些化学物质可能降低男性的精子数量。

hepatitis.en: Hepatitis is an illness that causes serious damage to the liver.
hepatitis.zh: 肝炎是一种严重损害肝脏的疾病。

chemotherapy.en: Chemotherapy kills cancer cells but can also damage healthy ones.
chemotherapy.zh: 化疗能杀死癌细胞,但也可能损伤健康细胞。

amino-acid.en: Proteins are made up of long chains of amino acids.
amino-acid.zh: 蛋白质由长链氨基酸构成。

abdominal.en: Common symptoms of the infection include fever and abdominal pain.
abdominal.zh: 这种感染的常见症状包括发烧和腹痛。

marrow.en: New blood cells are constantly produced in the bone marrow.
marrow.zh: 骨髓不断产生新的血细胞。

foetal.en: Smoking during pregnancy can seriously harm foetal development.
foetal.zh: 孕期吸烟会严重损害胎儿发育。

cortex.en: The outer layer of the brain, called the cortex, controls thinking and language.
cortex.zh: 大脑外层被称为皮层,控制思维和语言。

epidemiology.en: Epidemiology is the study of how diseases spread through populations.
epidemiology.zh: 流行病学研究疾病如何在人群中传播。

helix.en: Watson and Crick showed that DNA has the structure of a double helix.
helix.zh: 沃森和克里克证明了 DNA 具有双螺旋结构。

splice.en: Scientists can now splice genes from one organism into another.
splice.zh: 科学家现在可以把一种生物的基因拼接到另一种生物中。

capillary.en: Oxygen passes from the blood into the tissues through tiny capillaries.
capillary.zh: 氧气通过微小的毛细血管从血液进入组织。

thumb.en: The human thumb allows us to hold and use tools with great skill.
thumb.zh: 人的拇指使我们能灵巧地握持和使用工具。

plague.en: The plague killed about a third of the population of Europe in the 1300s.
plague.zh: 14 世纪的瘟疫造成欧洲约三分之一人口死亡。

plague.en: Rising costs continue to plague the national health service.
plague.zh: 不断上升的成本继续困扰着国家医疗服务体系。

lethal.en: Even a small amount of this poison can be lethal to humans.
lethal.zh: 即使少量这种毒药也可能对人类致命。

gland.en: The gland in the neck controls the speed of the body's metabolism.
gland.zh: 颈部的这个腺体控制着身体新陈代谢的速度。

bowel.en: A diet high in fibre may reduce the risk of bowel cancer.
bowel.zh: 高纤维饮食可能降低肠癌风险。

cavity.en: Sugar helps bacteria to create a cavity in a tooth.
cavity.zh: 糖会促使细菌在牙齿上形成蛀洞。

swallow.en: Older patients sometimes find it difficult to swallow large tablets.
swallow.zh: 老年患者有时很难吞咽大药片。

psychology.en: Studies in psychology show that people often copy those around them.
psychology.zh: 心理学研究表明,人们常常模仿周围的人。

psychologist.en: The psychologist asked children to wait alone before eating a sweet.
psychologist.zh: 这位心理学家让孩子们独自等待一段时间再吃糖。

cognitive.en: Learning a second language may improve certain cognitive skills.
cognitive.zh: 学习第二语言可能提高某些认知能力。

cognition.en: Poor sleep has a clear effect on cognition in older adults.
cognition.zh: 睡眠不足对老年人的认知有明显影响。

perception.en: The colour of food can change our perception of its taste.
perception.zh: 食物的颜色会改变我们对味道的感知。

perception.en: Public perception of the risk has changed since the accident.
perception.zh: 事故发生后,公众对这一风险的看法有所改变。

sensory.en: Babies receive a great deal of sensory information from the world around them.
sensory.zh: 婴儿从周围世界接收大量感官信息。

memory.en: Regular sleep helps to strengthen long-term memory in adults.
memory.zh: 规律睡眠有助于增强成年人的长期记忆。

recall.en: Participants were asked to recall as many words as possible from the list.
recall.zh: 参与者被要求尽可能多地回忆起列表中的单词。

retrieve.en: The brain may find it harder to retrieve information as we age.
retrieve.zh: 随着年龄增长,大脑提取信息可能变得更难。

intelligence.en: Early tests of intelligence were criticised for being unfair to certain groups.
intelligence.zh: 早期的智力测试因对某些群体不公平而受到批评。

iq.en: A high IQ does not guarantee success in later life.
iq.zh: 高智商并不能保证日后的成功。

intuition.en: Experienced doctors often rely on intuition when making quick decisions.
intuition.zh: 有经验的医生在快速决策时常常依靠直觉。

consciousness.en: Scientists still do not fully understand how the brain produces consciousness.
consciousness.zh: 科学家仍未完全理解大脑如何产生意识。

subconscious.en: Subconscious memories may influence the choices people make without their realising it.
subconscious.zh: 潜意识中的记忆可能在不知不觉中影响人们的选择。

emotion.en: Music can produce strong emotion even in very young children.
emotion.zh: 音乐甚至能让很小的孩子产生强烈的情感。

emotional.en: Family support is important for the emotional health of teenagers.
emotional.zh: 家庭支持对青少年的情感健康很重要。

mood.en: Bright sunlight has a positive effect on mood for most people.
mood.zh: 对大多数人来说,明媚的阳光对心情有积极影响。

anxiety.en: Many students suffer from anxiety in the weeks before an exam.
anxiety.zh: 许多学生在考前几周感到焦虑。

stress.en: Long working hours are a major cause of stress among office staff.
stress.zh: 长时间工作是办公室员工压力的主要来源。

trauma.en: Survivors of the earthquake may suffer from trauma for many years.
trauma.zh: 地震幸存者可能多年遭受心理创伤。

phobia.en: A phobia of spiders can be treated through gradual exposure.
phobia.zh: 蜘蛛恐惧症可以通过逐步接触来治疗。

personality.en: Twin studies suggest that genes play a role in shaping personality.
personality.zh: 双胞胎研究表明,基因在塑造个性方面起着作用。

temperament.en: Babies show differences in temperament from the first weeks of life.
temperament.zh: 婴儿从出生头几周起就表现出性情上的差异。

motivation.en: Students with strong motivation tend to perform better at school.
motivation.zh: 动机强的学生往往在学校表现更好。

incentive.en: Lower taxes provide an incentive for companies to invest in clean energy.
incentive.zh: 减税激励公司投资清洁能源。

reward.en: Animals learn more quickly when they receive a reward for correct behaviour.
reward.zh: 动物因正确行为得到奖励时学得更快。

punishment.en: Experts believe that physical punishment does little to improve behaviour.
punishment.zh: 专家认为体罚对改善行为几乎没有帮助。

habit.en: It takes several weeks of practice to form a new habit.
habit.zh: 养成一个新习惯需要几周的练习。

attention.en: Young children can pay attention to a single task for only a short time.
attention.zh: 幼儿只能在短时间内把注意力集中在一项任务上。

concentration.en: Loud noise can seriously affect concentration in the classroom.
concentration.zh: 巨大的噪音可能严重影响课堂上的专注力。

concentration.en: The concentration of carbon dioxide in the air continues to rise.
concentration.zh: 空气中二氧化碳的浓度继续上升。

distraction.en: Mobile phones are a major distraction for students during lessons.
distraction.zh: 手机是学生上课时的主要分心来源。

multitasking.en: Research suggests that multitasking reduces the quality of people's work.
multitasking.zh: 研究表明,多任务处理会降低工作质量。

decision-making.en: Lack of sleep has a negative effect on decision-making.
decision-making.zh: 睡眠不足对决策有负面影响。

reasoning.en: Children develop the ability to use logical reasoning at about the age of seven.
reasoning.zh: 儿童大约在七岁时发展出运用逻辑推理的能力。

judgement.en: Tiredness affects judgement and increases the risk of road accidents.
judgement.zh: 疲劳影响判断力,增加交通事故风险。

stimulus.en: The rats quickly learned to respond to the new stimulus.
stimulus.zh: 老鼠很快学会了对新的刺激作出反应。

response.en: Participants' response to the images was measured using brain scans.
response.zh: 参与者对图像的反应通过脑部扫描测量。

reflex.en: Pulling your hand away from something hot is a natural reflex.
reflex.zh: 把手从烫的东西上缩回是一种自然反射。

conditioning.en: Pavlov's work on conditioning showed that dogs could learn to expect food.
conditioning.zh: 巴甫洛夫关于条件反射的研究表明,狗能学会期待食物。

infant.en: An infant can recognise its mother's voice within days of birth.
infant.zh: 婴儿出生几天内就能辨认出母亲的声音。

toddler.en: A toddler may learn several new words every single day.
toddler.zh: 学步儿童每天可能学会几个新词。

adolescent.en: Most adolescents need more sleep than either children or adults.
adolescent.zh: 大多数青少年比儿童和成年人都需要更多睡眠。

adolescence.en: The brain continues to change in important ways during adolescence.
adolescence.zh: 在青春期,大脑继续发生重要变化。

peer.en: Young children often learn new skills by watching their peers.
peer.zh: 幼儿常常通过观察同龄人学习新技能。

peer-pressure.en: Peer pressure is one of the main reasons why teenagers start smoking.
peer-pressure.zh: 同伴压力是青少年开始吸烟的主要原因之一。

self-esteem.en: Praise from teachers can help to build self-esteem in young children.
self-esteem.zh: 老师的表扬有助于增强幼儿的自尊。

confidence.en: Learning a musical instrument can give children greater confidence.
confidence.zh: 学习乐器能让孩子更加自信。

confidence.en: Public confidence in the health system fell after the scandal.
confidence.zh: 丑闻发生后,公众对医疗系统的信任下降了。

empathy.en: Reading novels may help children to develop empathy towards others.
empathy.zh: 读小说可能有助于孩子培养对他人的同理心。

altruism.en: Some birds show altruism by helping to raise the young of others.
altruism.zh: 有些鸟表现出利他行为,帮助抚养其他鸟的幼鸟。

introvert.en: An introvert usually prefers quiet activities to large social events.
introvert.zh: 内向者通常更喜欢安静的活动,而不是大型社交活动。

extrovert.en: An extrovert tends to gain energy from being around other people.
extrovert.zh: 外向者往往从与他人相处中获得能量。

creativity.en: Schools can encourage creativity by allowing more time for art and play.
creativity.zh: 学校可以留出更多时间给艺术和游戏,以鼓励创造力。

imagination.en: Reading stories helps to develop the imagination of young children.
imagination.zh: 读故事有助于培养幼儿的想象力。

nature-versus-nurture.en: The debate on nature versus nurture has continued for more than a century.
nature-versus-nurture.zh: 关于先天与后天的争论已持续了一个多世纪。

placebo-effect.en: The placebo effect shows that people's beliefs can influence their recovery.
placebo-effect.zh: 安慰剂效应表明,人的信念能影响康复。

well-being.en: Spending time outdoors can improve people's general sense of well-being.
well-being.zh: 在户外活动可以提升人们整体的幸福感。

intellect.en: The author believed that a good education could develop the intellect of any child.
intellect.zh: 作者认为,良好的教育能发展任何孩子的才智。

rational.en: Economists once assumed that consumers always made rational choices.
rational.zh: 经济学家曾假定消费者总会作出理性的选择。

impulsive.en: Teenagers can be more impulsive than adults because their brains are still developing.
impulsive.zh: 青少年可能比成年人更冲动,因为他们的大脑仍在发育。

egocentric.en: Very young children are naturally egocentric and find it hard to share.
egocentric.zh: 很小的孩子天生以自我为中心,很难与人分享。

engrossed.en: The children were so engrossed in the game that they did not hear the bell.
engrossed.zh: 孩子们全神贯注地玩游戏,连铃声都没听到。

desire.en: The desire for social approval influences much of our behaviour.
desire.zh: 渴望得到社会认可影响着我们的许多行为。

passion.en: Her passion for science began when she was given a telescope as a child.
passion.zh: 她对科学的激情始于童年时得到的一架望远镜。

obedience.en: A famous experiment on obedience shocked the public in the 1960s.
obedience.zh: 20 世纪 60 年代,一项著名的服从实验震惊了公众。

dissonance.en: Cognitive dissonance occurs when people's actions conflict with their beliefs.
dissonance.zh: 当人们的行为与信念冲突时,就会出现认知失调。

body-language.en: Body language can reveal what people really feel about each other.
body-language.zh: 肢体语言能透露人们对彼此的真实感受。

social-interaction.en: Babies need plenty of social interaction in order to develop normally.
social-interaction.zh: 婴儿需要大量社会交往才能正常发育。

behavioural.en: Behavioural changes are often the first sign of the illness.
behavioural.zh: 行为变化往往是这种疾病的最初迹象。

cue.en: Babies use visual cues to work out what adults are feeling.
cue.zh: 婴儿利用视觉提示来判断成年人的感受。

psychiatric.en: Many patients with psychiatric problems also suffer from poor physical health.
psychiatric.zh: 许多有精神问题的患者身体健康状况也较差。

encode.en: The brain may encode new information more effectively during periods of rest.
encode.zh: 大脑在休息时也许能更有效地编码新信息。

innate.en: Some psychologists argue that the ability to learn language is innate.
innate.zh: 一些心理学家认为,学习语言的能力是天生的。

volition.en: Participants took part of their own volition and could leave at any time.
volition.zh: 参与者是自愿参加的,可以随时退出。

fantasy.en: Young children often find it difficult to separate fantasy from reality.
fantasy.zh: 幼儿常常很难区分幻想和现实。

nightmare.en: Stress and anxiety can increase the frequency of a person's nightmares.
nightmare.zh: 压力和焦虑可能增加一个人做噩梦的频率。

panic.en: News of the disease caused panic across the country.
panic.zh: 这种疾病的消息引起了全国恐慌。

panic.en: People tend to panic when they do not have clear information.
panic.zh: 人们在没有明确信息时容易恐慌。

obsession.en: The modern obsession with thinness can damage young people's health.
obsession.zh: 现代人对瘦的痴迷可能损害年轻人的健康。

apprehension.en: Many patients feel some apprehension before a major operation.
apprehension.zh: 许多患者在大手术前会感到一些忧虑。

mentality.en: Changing the mentality of a whole industry can take many years.
mentality.zh: 改变整个行业的思维方式可能需要很多年。
